summary: The midday recovery has faded, with the Sensex slipping back to about 400 down as a fresh bond sell-off weighs on rate-sensitive sectors. Pharma is still the only real support.

detail.leaders: Nifty Pharma and Healthcare; block-deal names AXISCADES and TCI Express
detail.laggards: Rate-sensitive financials (HDFC Bank, Bajaj Finance, HDFC Life); FMCG, Auto; Tata Motors PV
detail.tone: Worse than 12:30: the Nifty was 22,716.40 (−0.28%) at noon, but the latest headline has the Sensex down about 400. That puts the Nifty back near 22,650, with bond yields capping the rebound.
watch: The 10-year G-Sec yield: a move above 7.2% would hurt banks further
Expiry settlement in the final 90 minutes

src.title: Business Standard — Stock Market LIVE, Sept 29

top.title: India 10-yr yield hits 7.19%, a 2½-year high
top.line: Highest since April 2024 on oil, a weak rupee and the RBI's ₹1 trn OMO bond sales
more: The yield eased slightly to about 7.18% after the spike
US 10-yr near 5.27% adds to the global bond sell-off

src.title: Business Standard — G-Sec yields surge to 2.5-year high on crude spike

top.title: Most economists now see an RBI hike Oct 7
top.line: 35 of 61 in a Reuters poll expect a 25 bp repo hike to 5.50% at the Oct 5–7 MPC
more: It would be the first increase since February 2023
A majority also see another hike in December
August inflation was 4.82%; the rupee is down about 6% this year
